result.detail: Design choice, taken from the microarchitecture: when m_free is true and the skid register is empty, m_data loads s_data even if s_valid is low. This is allowed because m_data is undefined while m_valid is low (interface spec section 5), and the hold rule still holds because m_free is false whenever a beat is stalled. The data registers are not reset, as the microarchitecture specifies. The testbench therefore compares m_data only while the model holds a beat, and uses !== so that X values count as failures. The WIDTH 1 lane receives bit 0 of the WIDTH 8 stimulus and is checked against bit 0 of the model. The formal proof (two .sby jobs in the plan, or one job with [tasks]) should be assigned to a separate task or follow-up; I did not include it here so that an unverified proof cannot gate this task.
